Marrowby's Bicycle Workshop

4 Tannery Lane, Velmora. Family-run bike repairs since 1987.

Opening hours

  • Monday to Friday: 08:30 to 17:30
  • Saturday: 10:00 to 14:00
  • Sunday: closed

Services

Brake and gear adjustments while you wait (about 30 minutes), wheel truing, e-bike checks. A brake service costs 18 euros.
